test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some crayon is colour.

No colour is water.

Some water is liquid.

**Conclusions:**

I) Some crayon is liquid.

II) Some crayon is not water.

III) Some liquid is not colour.
solution:
Statements:

Some crayon is colour.

No colour is water.

Some water is liquid.

The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c053342b151614767948661d0411898e4fdc397510e5109b49a87e71674a03e.png] 

Conclusions:

I) Some crayon is liquid - **False** (because there is no direct relation between crayon and liquid, So it can be possible only).

II) Some crayon is not water - **True** (because some colour is crayon and no colour is water, so the part of crayon which is colour can never be water).

III) Some liquid is not colour - **True** (because some liquid is water and no colour is water, so the part of liquid which is water can never be colour).

Thus, Only II and III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
